The '''Dark Sanctum''' was a buried ruin located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], it was undergoing excavation by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], but [[Slavery/Legends|rebelling slaves]] from the nearby [[Unfinished colossus|work site]] took over the ruins. The Empire had a small outpost just north of the ruins.
